summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, announcing the appointment of Catherine McLeod-Seltzer to its board of directors, effective September 1, 2026. The news release details her extensive mining industry experience, including roles at Teck Resources, Kinross Gold, Bear Creek Mining, and Lucara Diamond. No financial terms, transaction details, or strategic actions are involved. This is a routine governance announcement, not a special-situation event. The filing is a standard disclosure of a board appointment and does not constitute a transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review.
